Given id 11 (the next free integer) rather than a renumbered/fractional id so ids 1-10 and their dependsOn chains stay untouched; see the `phaseNumbering` note above and docs/PHASE-5-CHANNELS.md's own rename note for the full context.
deliverables: packages/domain/src/eligibility.ts: LicenseType; EligibilityRuleCategory/Outcome; EligibilityExceptionType/RiskLevel; driverInputSchema/eligibilityCustomerInputSchema (new request-boundary input — Steps 1-4 never collect age/license/passport/nationality); EligibilityPolicyRules/EligibilityPolicy (versioned, configurable); EligibilityException; PolicyConflictCode; EligibilityDecisionStatus/Result

MASTER-PLAN.md journey Step 6, the journey-step-numbered continuation of Phases 1-4 (each already a single journey step); given id 12 (the next free integer after id 11's Eligibility) rather than a renumbered id, matching id 11's own precedent of appending rather than disturbing ids 1-10's numbering.
